name: Astron Energy Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: South African citizens under 35, with at least a 70% average; fields include engineering, IT, computer science, finance, accounting, commerce and data analytics.
documents: Certified ID documents of parents or guardians
Proof of other bursary or NSFAS funding where applicable
Certified academic records and registration proof where applicable
notes: Closes 12:00 midday on Monday 26 Oct 2026; several bursary listing sites agree on this date. Applications are online and the bursary is administered by Excel@Uni. We have not found an official Astron Energy page, so no link is shown. Listed fields differ between sites; check the application portal before applying.

name: NSFAS 2027
whoItsFor: Students at public universities and TVET colleges who qualify financially.
documents: Declaration or disability forms where applicable
Orphan and vulnerable child form where applicable
notes: The 2027 closing date is 31 Oct 2026, as reported after the Minister confirmed it on 22 Sep and NSFAS said there will be no extension. An earlier announcement gave 18 Nov, so confirm on the myNSFAS portal. TVET college admissions for 2027 closed on 30 Sep 2026.

name: ISFAP Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: First-year undergraduates in 2027 from households earning R600,000 a year or less, accepted at a partner university, in selected fields.
documents: Signed ISFAP funding application consent form
Certified ID documents of parents, guardians and household earners
notes: Fields and partner universities change yearly. Confirm the portal status before applying.
